Our Story

Everyday food, treated like it matters

The story's pretty simple: somebody got tired of 2am food options being either terrible or nonexistent, so the kitchen just never stopped. That was the whole idea.

The menu hasn't changed much since, and it probably won't. Same pasta and grilled plates whether it's the lunch rush or three in the morning, made by people who'd rather get it right than get it out fast.

4.9 stars from 99 people on Google. We didn't expect that either.
